generateMissingTrackCircuits(railyard, TCTypes, delimUserTypes, virtualTCType, namer=None, areaRestriction=None)

 

Generate virtual track circuits covering all edges not contained in any track circuit.

This function returns a list of generated areas of user type virtualTCType. These areas cover all edges in the graph areaRestriction that are not contained in a registered area having user type in TCTypes. The generated areas are delimited by objects having user types in delimUserTypes.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard we are examining.
  • TCTypes (Iterable(str)) - The user types of track circuits.
  • delimUserTypes (Iterable(str)) - The user types of track circuit delimiters typically corresponding to the TCTypes.
  • virtualTCType (str) - The new type of the generated virtual track circuits.
  • namer (any | none) - A callable having signature (railyard, edge) -> str. namer should return the desired name for the virtual track circuit that will be generated from edge.
  • areaRestriction (IGraph | none) - The area the generated virtual track circuits are restricted to. Default is the full railyard graph.
Returns: [IGraph]
The generated virtual track circuits covering the edges not belonging to a track circuit.

buildTrackCircuitPath(path, railyard, TCTypes=None, allowFork=False)

 

Function returning the "shifted path" of a given path.

The shift pS of a path p is obtained from p as follows:

  • The starting point of p is moved forward until it touches the beginning of a track circuit, i.e. the segment after the starting point of pS will be contained in a track circuit beginning at the starting point of pS, given that the length of pS is not zero (in which case None is returned). Note that this may move the starting point over segments not contained in track circuits.
  • If the last segment of p is contained in a track circuit, the end point of p is moved forward in the same way as the starting point of p. In this process, the search forward might fork (typically over a switch). This gives an error if the parameter allowFork is False (the default). If allowFork is True, then the shifted path is forked along the lowest index.
  • If the last segment of p is _not_ contained in a track circuit, the end point of p is instead moved in the other direction, towards the beginning of the path, until a track circuit boundary is reached.

Thus pS will either be None (if p does not have any "internal" track circuits) or it will have its first and last segment contained in some track circuit(s).

Also note that it is required that every track segment encountered is contained in at most one track circuit (as defined by the argument TCTypes).

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) - The base path which the shifted path is calculated with respect to.
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard were the shifted path is calculated (the path must be a path in the graph of railyard, but it does not have to be registered there).
  • TCTypes (Iterable(str) | str | none) - The user types that denote track circuits (subtypes of the base type Area). Note that a string argument will be, interpreted as a 1-tuple, not as a character-iterable. An argument of None will be interpreted as "no restriction", i.e. the same as if TCTypes is the set of all user subtypes of base type Area.
  • allowFork (bool) - If True, then forking of the shifted end point is allowed.
Returns: IPath | none
The shifted path, None if the shifted path has length 0.
